title: ICP-001 - Visual and documentation inspection
scope: Visual and documentation inspection only. No electrical testing, measurement, energized work or verification of conformity with any standard.
safety_notes: Only qualified and authorized personnel may open the panel. Follow site lockout/tagout rules.
This procedure never establishes that the panel is de-energized, safe or correctly wired.
Do not touch conductors or terminals during the inspection.
ai_guidance: Industrial low-voltage control panel. Assess photos only for visible condition, identification and documentation. Never conclude electrical safety, de-energization, correct wiring, conformity, voltage, continuity, insulation or torque from a photo.

requirements.title: Enclosure exterior condition
requirements.instructions: Inspect the enclosure exterior for impact damage, corrosion, missing fixings and signs of water or dust ingress.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the whole enclosure from the front, door closed, including the bottom cable entries if visible.
visual_limitations: The IP rating cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Door, latch and warning label
requirements.instructions: Check the door closes and latches, the gasket is intact and the electrical hazard warning label is present and legible.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the warning label on the door so the symbol and text are readable.
visual_limitations: Gasket compression cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Main switch identification and handle
requirements.instructions: Check the main switch is identified (Q1), the handle is intact and the ON/OFF positions are marked.
requirements.photo_guidance: Front photo of the main switch showing the handle, plate and tag.
visual_limitations: The switch position does not prove the circuit is de-energized.

requirements.title: Circuit breaker identification and condition
requirements.instructions: Check each breaker has a circuit label and shows no visible damage or heat discoloration.
requirements.photo_guidance: Photograph the row of breakers straight on, close enough to read the labels.
visual_limitations: Trip characteristics and ratings cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: 24 VDC power supply visual check
requirements.instructions: Inspect the power supply: identification, external damage, signs of overheating, labels and visible connections.
inspection_points: Check for visual signs of overheating
recommended_actions: Refer suspected overheating to an electrician
requirements.photo_guidance: Front photo of the power supply including its tag and terminal area.
visual_limitations: Output voltage and terminal tightness cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: PLC visual and documentation check
requirements.instructions: Check the PLC and I/O module are identified (A1), undamaged, and document the visible status indicators.
recommended_actions: Refer fault indications to controls engineer
requirements.photo_guidance: Front photo of the PLC CPU and I/O module with indicators visible.
visual_limitations: Indicator lights do not prove correct program or I/O function.

requirements.title: Contactors visual check
requirements.instructions: Check contactors K1 and K2 are identified and show no cracks, melting or discoloration.
requirements.photo_guidance: Front photo of both contactors with their tags.
visual_limitations: Contact wear and coil condition are not visible.

requirements.title: Auxiliary relays seated
requirements.instructions: Confirm all four relays are present and fully seated in their sockets (visual only, do not touch).

requirements.title: Terminal strip marking
requirements.instructions: Check terminal strip X1 is labelled, terminal markers are present and PE terminals are identifiable.
possible_findings: Exposed conductor at terminal (for human review)
requirements.photo_guidance: Close photo of the terminal strip with markers readable.
visual_limitations: Terminal torque and conductor insertion depth cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Duct covers fitted
requirements.instructions: Confirm all duct covers are fitted and wires are routed inside the ducts.

requirements.title: DIN rails secure
requirements.instructions: Confirm rails are fixed and devices do not appear displaced (visual only).

requirements.title: Visible wiring condition
requirements.instructions: Look for exposed conductors, damaged insulation, wires outside ducts or visibly disconnected ends.
recommended_actions: Stop and refer to a qualified electrician
requirements.photo_guidance: Overall photo of the open panel interior, in good light.
visual_limitations: Continuity, insulation resistance and correct wiring cannot be verified from a photograph.

requirements.title: Device identification labels present
requirements.instructions: Confirm tags Q1, G1, A1, K1, K2 and X1 are present and legible.

requirements.title: Protective earth bar
requirements.instructions: Check the PE bar is present, identified and PE conductors appear connected (visual only).
acceptance_criteria: PE bar present and conductors visibly connected
recommended_actions: Refer to qualified electrician for continuity test
requirements.photo_guidance: Close photo of the PE bar and its conductors.
visual_limitations: Earth continuity can only be verified by measurement, never from a photograph.

requirements.title: Mounting plate secure
requirements.instructions: Confirm the mounting plate is fixed and shows no deformation.
